title: Medicine
coreMove: Ask what care a treatment visibly displays in addition to what health effect it may produce.
sourcePressure: The source frames medicine partly as conspicuous caring, where visible sacrifice and public signs of care matter alongside health claims.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer turns medicine into placebo theater or anti-medical cynicism.

sourceAnchors.name: medicine as conspicuous caring
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says medicine may function partly as conspicuous caring.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The treatment reassures partly because care has become visible.

sourceAnchors.name: visible sacrifice and public signals of care
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says visible sacrifice and public signals of care matter alongside health claims.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Time, pain, expense, and attention can show that nobody is being abandoned.

sourceAnchors.name: care signals alongside health claims
sourceAnchors.detail: The source keeps health claims in frame while adding the signaling account.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The body can need the medicine while the family also needs to see care being spent.

hook: the-elephant-in-the-brain-ch14: do not open with a confession that everyone has hidden motives

counterintuition: the-elephant-in-the-brain-ch14: no blanket cynicism that turns all public reasons into lies
the-elephant-in-the-brain-ch14: avoid a simple pure-versus-fake contrast

examples: the-elephant-in-the-brain-ch14: no office meeting with a whiteboard as the default scene

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

exampleSpecs.audience: a clinician deciding whether a low-value visible action calms a family
exampleSpecs.stakes: parents need care to be seen but the child needs appropriate treatment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Matthew explains why the child does not need an antibiotic, then offers a concrete monitoring card that makes attention visible without fake treatment.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The exam-room printer warms beside a box of tongue depressors.

exampleSpecs.audience: a nurse making invisible care legible to siblings
exampleSpecs.stakes: family conflict rises when care work cannot be seen
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Beatrice lays the medication schedule, stair plan, and home-visit times on one sheet so Pavel sees care in coordinated work rather than another dramatic test.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A pill organizer clicks shut on the discharge desk.

exampleSpecs.audience: a physiotherapist managing demand for dramatic imaging
exampleSpecs.stakes: a scan may signal seriousness even when rehab work matters more
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Can we just get an MRI?" Iris asks, and Min shows the strength-test baseline that will prove care every Friday.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Can we just get an MRI?" Iris asks before touching the resistance band.

exampleSpecs.audience: a physician making remote care feel real without over-treating
exampleSpecs.stakes: distance can make care seem absent unless effort is visible
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You have Marco mail the pulse oximeter, schedule a named callback, and show Hanna exactly what readings trigger escalation.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the frozen video frame just as the cough starts.

exampleSpecs.audience: a clinic director reducing performative burden while preserving visible attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: long forms may signal seriousness while exhausting the patient
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Beatrice one abandoned intake to replace the thick packet with a same-day call and a visible care plan.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Beatrice one abandoned packet to question what the paperwork signaled.

exampleSpecs.audience: a surgeon deciding how to show care without turning updates into theater
exampleSpecs.stakes: families read silence as neglect even when work is happening
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What does the family know when the operating-room door stays closed for four hours?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What fills the waiting room when no one names the work being done?

skillTargets: distinguish health effect from visible care signal
design communication that makes real care legible without fake burden

tryThisNowSpec: Think of one care act you owe someone. Make the real work visible with a time, note, checklist, or callback instead of adding empty drama.
